headline: Davis & Elkins stop Charleston's winning run
dek: Davis & Elkins held Charleston to a draw at home, ending a run of eight straight Charleston wins that began after Davis & Elkins won at Charleston. Charleston have not beaten them in two meetings, and Davis & Elkins have conceded nine goals in seventeen matches all season.
displaced_by: Davis & Elkins' home draw with Charleston ended Charleston's eight-match winning run, and the old dek's eight conceded in sixteen matches is now nine in seventeen.
